measurements.participant_count: Distinct human actor_user_id across bundle identity decisions, claim assessments and accepted values with actor_role != machine, per declared principal, compared with the declared principals.
measurements.completion: 3 projects x 5 stages = 15 (project, stage) pairs. A pair counts only if the final /journey status is complete and that stage's bundle part verifies (status ok; write needs a verified release check). Published as k/15 plus per-stage k/3.
measurements.correction_burden: Human rows that override or amend machine or earlier output: identity merges and splits (corpus.json decisions), accepted values whose value equals no cited machine observation, superseding claim versions and superseding assessments; raw and per included report. Adjudicated screening resolutions are not in bundle v1 and are published as null.
measurements.disputed_claim_resolution_time: Per claim version whose first assessment stance is not supporting, or whose stance observation disagrees with its final tip: seconds from the first such row's created_at to the final tip's created_at; n, median, max.
measurements.export_completeness: parts_ok/7 (present, checksum-verified, body hash recomputed) plus reconstruction: known-answer PRISMA counts, exclusion reasons, accepted values and claim support equal the gold; real projects: every full-text exclusion has a reason, every claim passage slices to its text, every run's effective_plan_hash recomputes from methods.json.
